rows.name: START POINT
rows.description: White tower, 91 feet high, on East point of Sanda Island, Ronaldsha Firth

rows.name: NORTH RONALDSHA
rows.description: Brick tower, 139 feet high, on North point of Orkney Islands

rows.name: SUMBURGH HEAD
rows.description: Stone tower, 55 ft. high, on the S.W. point of the Shetlands

rows.name: BRESSAY
rows.character: One rev. red & br. lt., 1 m.
rows.description: White tower, 53 ft. high, on E. side of entrance to Lerwick. Lt. red and bright alternately A small fixed red light on Lerwick pier

rows.name: WHALSEY SKERRIES
rows.description: White tower, 98 ft. high, on Bound Skerry

rows.name: NORTH UNST
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 64 ft. high, on Muckle Flugga, N. part of Id. Lt. is red towards the Skaw of Unst, betw. S.E. by E. ¼ E. & S.E. by S. ½ S.

rows.name: CAPE WRATH
rows.character: One rev. red & br. lt., 1 m.
rows.description: White tower, 65 ft. high. Flashes bright and red alternately

rows.name: RU STOER
rows.description: White tower, 47 ft. high, on S. Ear. Light is visible 1 min., and then eclipsed ½ min.

rows.name: SOUTH RONA
rows.description: White tower, 42 feet high, on N.E. point of island. Light visible between W. by S. ½ S. and S.S.W., through North, East, and South

rows.name: Kyle Akin, Loch Alsh
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: On S.W. point of Gillean Island. Lt. bright in fairways of Applecross Sound and Loch Alsh, betw. N.N.W. and N.W. by W., and betw. S.E. ¾ E. and S.E. by E. ¼ E. Masked between N. by E. ¾ E. and S.E. by E. ¼ E. Red elsewhere

rows.name: Oronsay Island
rows.description: White tower, 63 ft. high, on island, N.W. part of Sleat Sound. Light visible betw. N. ¼ W. and S.W. ¾ W., through N., E., and S.

rows.name: BUTT OF LEWIS
rows.description: White tower, 120 ft. high. Lt. visible seaward from S. by E. ½ E. to W. by S. ½ S.

rows.name: Ness
rows.description: Fixed lt., red towards entr., bright over harb.

rows.name: Stornoway
rows.character: 1. One rev. br. lt., ½ m. 2. One fixed bright lt. 3. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. White tower, 45 ft. high, on Arnish Point... 2. A prism on beacon, on S.E. end of reef, reflects light from a lower window between E. by S. and S. by E.; visible in entering... 3. Gas light on the wharf

rows.name: East Loch Tarbert
rows.description: One fixed red light on new pier at head

rows.name: MONACH ISLES
rows.description: White tower, 133 ft. high, on Shillay Island

rows.name: GLASS ISLAND
rows.description: White tower, 100 ft. high, on East point of Scalpay, Harris Isles

rows.name: Loch Skiport
rows.description: Red light on pier when steamers expected

rows.name: USHENISH
rows.description: White tower, 39 ft. high, E. side of S. Uist. Lt. is bright 8 secs., eclipsed 16 secs. Shown between N.E. ½ N. and S.S.W.

rows.name: Loch Boisdale
rows.description: Red light on pier when steamers expected

rows.name: Castle Bay
rows.description: Red light on pier when steamers expected

rows.name: BARRA HEAD
rows.description: Stone tower, 60 ft. high, on summit of Bernera Island. Lt. visible 30 secs., eclipsed 30 secs.

rows.name: SKERRYVORE
rows.description: Granite tower, 158 ft. high, on the rock

rows.name: DUBH ARTACH ROCKS
rows.character: One fixed or occulting bright light
rows.description: Tower, 126 ft. high, on rock off Iona Sound. Light is occulting towards S. coast of Iona and Torranan Rocks, or between E. ½ S. and N. by E. ½ E.; visible for 10 and 30 secs. alternately at intervals of 10 secs.

rows.name: ARDNAMURCHAN
rows.description: Stone tower, 118 ft. high, on the point. Shown between N.E. by E. ½ E. and S.W. by S. ¾ S.
